originalTitle: Lyft (LYFT) Outpaces Stock Market Gains: What You Should Know
summary: Lyft (LYFT) closed the most recent trading day at $15.32, moving +2% from the previous trading session.
content:
Lyft (LYFT) closed the most recent trading day at $15.32, moving +2% from the previous trading session. This move outpaced the S&P 500's daily gain of 0.86%. Meanwhile, the Dow gained 0.98%, and the Nasdaq, a tech-heavy index, added 0.96%.

The ride-hailing company's shares have seen a decrease of 12.32% over the last month, not keeping up with the Computer and Technology sector's loss of 0.56% and the S&P 500's loss of 1.96%.

Analysts and investors alike will be keeping a close eye on the performance of Lyft in its upcoming earnings disclosure. The company's earnings per share (EPS) are projected to be $0.44, reflecting a 69.23% increase from the same quarter last year. Simultaneously, our latest consensus estimate expects the revenue to be $1.93 billion, showing a 14.67% escalation compared to the year-ago quarter.

In terms of the entire fiscal year, the Zacks Consensus Estimates predict earnings of $1.58 per share and a revenue of $7.32 billion, indicating changes of +229.17% and +15.94%, respectively, from the former year.

Any recent changes to analyst estimates for Lyft should also be noted by investors. Such recent modifications usually signify the changing landscape of near-term business trends. As a result, we can interpret positive estimate revisions as a good sign for the business outlook.

Our research suggests that these changes in estimates have a direct relationship with upcoming stock price performance. To capitalize on this, we've crafted the Zacks Rank, a unique model that incorporates these estimate changes and offers a practical rating system.

The Zacks Rank system, ranging from #1 (Strong Buy) to #5 (Strong Sell), possesses a remarkable history of outdoing, externally audited, with #1 stocks returning an average annual gain of +25% since 1988. Over the last 30 days, the Zacks Consensus EPS estimate has witnessed an unchanged state. Right now, Lyft possesses a Zacks Rank of #3 (Hold).

In terms of valuation, Lyft is currently trading at a Forward P/E ratio of 9.51. This signifies a discount in comparison to the average Forward P/E of 15.96 for its industry.

Meanwhile, LYFT's PEG ratio is currently 0.48. The PEG ratio bears resemblance to the frequently used P/E ratio, but this parameter also includes the company's expected earnings growth trajectory. The Internet - Services industry currently had an average PEG ratio of 1.48 as of yesterday's close.

The Internet - Services industry is part of the Computer and Technology sector. Currently, this industry holds a Zacks Industry Rank of 200, positioning it in the bottom 19% of all 250+ industries.

The strength of our individual industry groups is measured by the Zacks Industry Rank, which is calculated based on the average Zacks Rank of the individual stocks within these groups. Our research shows that the top 50% rated industries outperform the bottom half by a factor of 2 to 1.

chineseTitle: Lyft (LYFT) 的涨幅超过股市：您应该知道什么
chineseSummary: Lyft (LYFT) 最近一个交易日收盘价为 15.32 美元，较前一交易日上涨 2%。
chineseContent:
Lyft (LYFT) 最近一个交易日收盘价为 15.32 美元，较前一交易日上涨 2%。这一举措超过了标准普尔 500 指数 0.86% 的日涨幅。与此同时，道指上涨 0.98%，以科技股为主的纳斯达克指数上涨 0.96%。

这家网约车公司的股价上个月下跌了 12.32%，低于计算机和技术板块 0.56% 的跌幅以及标准普尔 500 指数 1.96% 的跌幅。

分析师和投资者都将密切关注 Lyft 在即将公布的财报中的表现。该公司每股收益（EPS）预计为0.44美元，较去年同期增长69.23%。同时，我们最新的共识预计收入为 19.3 亿美元，较去年同期增长 14.67%。

就整个财年而言，Zacks 一致预期预计每股收益为 1.58 美元，营收为 73.2 亿美元，较上年分别变化 +229.17% 和 +15.94%。

投资者还应注意 Lyft 分析师预测的任何近期变化。最近的此类修改通常意味着近期业务趋势的变化。因此，我们可以将积极的估计修正解读为业务前景的好兆头。

我们的研究表明，这些预估变化与即将到来的股价表现有直接关系。为了利用这一点，我们精心设计了 Zacks Rank，这是一个独特的模型，融合了这些估计变化并提供了实用的评级系统。

Zacks Rank 系统的范围从#1（强力买入）到#5（强力卖出），拥有卓越的超越历史，经过外部审计，自 1988 年以来#1 股票的平均年收益为 +25%。在过去 30 天里，Zacks 共识每股收益估计保持不变。目前，Lyft 的 Zacks 排名为#3（持有）。

就估值而言，Lyft 目前的远期市盈率为 9.51。与该行业 15.96 的平均远期市盈率相比，这意味着存在折扣。

与此同时，LYFT 的 PEG 比率目前为 0.48。 PEG比率与常用的市盈率相似，但该参数还包括公司的预期盈利增长轨迹。截至昨天收盘，互联网服务行业目前的平均 PEG 率为 1.48。

互联网服务行业是计算机和技术行业的一部分。目前，该行业的 Zacks 行业排名为 200，在所有 250 多个行业中排名垫底 19%。

我们各个行业组的实力是通过 Zacks 行业排名来衡量的，该排名是根据这些组中个股的平均 Zacks 排名计算的。我们的研究表明，排名前 50% 的行业的表现比排名后一半的行业高出 2 比 1。
